# 文本清洗：相关学科综合示例
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
texts=["profit rose revenue improved","loss grew and guidance fell",
       "earnings beat expectations","higher expenses risk"]
y=[1,0,1,0]
v=TfidfVectorizer(ngram_range=(1,2))
X=v.fit_transform(texts)
clf=LogisticRegression().fit(X,y)
print("Words:",len(v.vocabulary_))
print("Class:",clf.predict(v.transform(["revenue and profit improved"])))

notes.code:
# 词性标注：相关学科综合示例
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
texts=["profit rose revenue improved","loss grew and guidance fell",
       "earnings beat expectations","higher expenses risk"]
y=[1,0,1,0]
v=TfidfVectorizer(ngram_range=(1,2))
X=v.fit_transform(texts)
clf=LogisticRegression().fit(X,y)
print("Words:",len(v.vocabulary_))
print("Class:",clf.predict(v.transform(["revenue and profit improved"])))
notes.application: 应用于价格图像、财报文本、市场新闻情绪与多ETF量化预测研究。
